description: The plot illustrates the relationship between an unspecified variable on the x-axis and the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" on the y-axis, comparing four different models. The x-axis is labeled with values ranging from approximately 0 to 1024, with a scale that appears to be linear, and tick labels at 0, 512, and 1024. The y-axis is labeled "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" with values ranging from 0.1 to 0.5, also on a linear scale, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1 from 0.1 to 0.5. The four lines represent different models: LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep (blue, circle markers, solid line), Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep (orange, square markers, solid line), LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench (green, triangle markers, solid line), and Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench (red, triangle markers, solid line). The blue line starts at approximately 0.26 and increases to around 0.62, with a notable rise between the first two x-values. The orange line begins at about 0.17, increases to around 0.59 at the second x-value, and then continues to rise to approximately 0.65. The green line starts at around 0.1, jumps to about 0.52 at the second x-value, and then reaches roughly 0.6. The red line begins at approximately 0.3, increases to around 0.56 at the second x-value, and then continues to rise to about 0.7. All lines exhibit an overall increasing trend across the x-axis.
